name: srt-to-script
description: Convert SRT subtitles into voice actor scripts (DOCX + PDF)

scripts.e2e: npm run build && npx vite preview --port 4173 & PID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:4173/ >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; node test/e2e.test.mjs; EXIT=$?; kill $PID 2>/dev/null; exit $EXIT
